ideas.pitch: A predictive spatial analysis dashboard forecasting municipal infrastructure failure in Ottawa using historical public works data, Poisson regression, and spatial clustering.
ideas.title: Ottawa Municipal Asset Risk Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of combining rigorous predictive modeling with a concrete civic use case, mirroring the data-heavy statistical wins seen in AI forecasting hackathons.

ideas.pitch: Satellite imagery monitoring tool tailored for Canadian environmental regulations, tracking industrial land usage changes and flagging unauthorized zoning clearings automatically.
ideas.title: CanGeo-Compliance AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly replicates the hard engineering and satellite-monitoring architecture of the GeoNex-ATLAS runner-up project, appealing to judges looking for tangible environmental and regulatory tech.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered regional nutrition and meal planning platform connecting local Ottawa farmers' market inventory directly to dietary meal prep recommendations for users.
ideas.title: LocalHarvest Ottawa
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies the localized health-tech success pattern from E-Foodiee, tailoring a consumer nutrition engine to a hyper-local geographical supply chain.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent RAG system built for university administrative navigation, utilizing LangGraph to route queries between academic advising, financial aid, and health services.
ideas.title: CampusPulse Multi-Agent Student Support
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven architecture of the Greennovation AI winning platform, focusing on robust workflow orchestration rather than a simple wrapper chatbot.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent platform that reviews local Ottawa community project proposals, verifies milestone deliverables via open data sources, and executes conditional USDC micro-grants.
ideas.title: CivicTrust Autonomous Micro-Grant Escrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines autonomous agent mechanics with secure decentralized escrow settlements, matching the winning architecture of the Dispatch marketplace project.
